_doc: Plain-albedo enemy materials for bake_char.py (the 3D-lit path, same material language as the baked Tech Ronin: flat material colour, real normals, emissive masks, no toon bands, rim or outline). Keys are the material names of enemy_style.json (the id pass writes their ids). Values are sRGB albedo, kept in the ronin's muted value range (dark armour, art bible section 5); the scene lamps and the grade do the shading. 'emissive' maps a material to a mask channel (r = attack glow, g = eyes, b = light strips). 'fold' lists, per character, emissive materials whose glow is dropped (kept as a dark albedo trim, like the ronin's hat brim): only intentional glows stay emissive. Values are technical placeholders pending art-director sign-off.
